title: Physical-Option-Dependent Crop-Root State Ownership Qualification

qualified_ownership.SWRD_1: actual root depth is derivable from committed DVS and immutable RDTB/RDM; no independent actual-root-depth state is required solely for the root-uptake view
qualified_ownership.SWRD_2: actual_root_depth and potential_root_depth are optional committed physical root state because both are history-dependent
qualified_ownership.SWRD_3: actual root depth is derivable from committed WRT and immutable RLWTB/RDM; no independent actual-root-depth state is required solely for the root-uptake view
qualified_ownership.SWRDC_nonadaptive: no persistent per-node distribution state is required; normalized distribution and cumulative-root-fraction view are reconstructible
qualified_ownership.SWRDC_1: an optional committed per-node root-biomass distribution or scientifically equivalent state is required

derived_not_persistent_by_default: rr and rrpot as same-update increments
wroot_node_top and lrv_node when reconstructible for the enabled consuming physics
transactional_requirement: enabled SWRD=2 and SWRDC=1 root state must be checkpointed, trialed, committed and rolled back atomically with crop evolution
memory_requirement: per-node adaptive root state is forbidden for columns/templates where SWRDC=1 is inactive
scope_limits: no production crop state type implemented
no arbitrary subdaily crop-root evolution qualified
